_readme: The cast: who speaks, and how they sound. `speaker` ids are NPC ids (packages/shared/src/rooms.ts) plus `ui` (signs, words, drills). Voices are free Microsoft Edge neural pt-BR voices (edge-tts); only Antonio (male) and Francisca (female) exist for pt-BR, so NPCs of the same sex are told apart by `rate` (speed, e.g. "-8%") and `pitch` (e.g. "-6Hz"). Changing a voice/rate/pitch re-bakes that speaker's clips on the next `pnpm tts`; `carlos` and `ui` have no tweaks so their existing clips stay.

ui.about: signs, menus, words in the Caderno, listening drills, the parrot

graca.about: Dona Graça, padeira da noite: older, slower, warm

nanda.about: Nanda, the hat shop: young and bright

julia.about: Júlia, guia da praça: clear and friendly

comissaria.about: Comissária Lia, the arrivals hall: gentle and welcoming

celia.about: Célia, the airport information desk: patient and kind

comandante.about: the captain over the PA, flight-in cutscene: calm, a little formal

agente.about: Agente Paulo, passport control: formal, a little stern

tia_lu.about: Tia Lu, feira: warm and a little loud

ze.about: Seu Zé, hortaliças: quick and chatty

chico.about: Seu Chico, pastel: deep and easygoing

bento.about: Seu Bento, aluguel de barcos: calm, a little gravelly, the sea in his voice

neide.about: Dona Neide, pescadora: slow, warm, sure of herself

jo.about: Jô, the beach kiosk: quick, sunny, calls everyone 'meu bem'
